title: 捷運最少坐幾站
question:
捷運有 n 個車站，編號 0 到 n - 1；有 m 段軌道，每段連接兩個車站，兩個方向都能坐。第一行輸入 n、m，接下來 m 行每行輸入一段軌道連接的兩個車站，最後一行輸入起點和終點，輸出最少要坐幾站；到不了就輸出「到不了」。
提示：用二維 list 存每個車站的鄰居（鄰接串列），用 deque 做 BFS。

en.title: Fewest MRT Stops
en.question:
An MRT has n stations, numbered 0 to n - 1. There are m tracks; each joins two stations and runs both ways. The first line is n and m. Then m lines, each with the two stations of one track. The last line is the start and the end. Output the fewest stops; if you cannot get there, output 到不了.
Tip: keep the neighbors of each station in a 2D list (an adjacency list), and use a deque for BFS.
